name: Remote Falcon
author: James Vance
description: Allows remote control of FPP from the Remote Falcon web application (https://remotefalcon.com)

privacy.summary: Connects your show to Remote Falcon so visitors can request or vote for songs from your phone-friendly viewer page. Sends your song list and what's playing to remotefalcon.com.

sends.what: your Show Token and the names of the songs playing now and next
sends.why: so your viewer page shows what's playing and the plugin can fetch the next request or vote

sends.what: your remote playlist's song names, lengths and order
sends.why: so visitors can pick from your song list

sends.what: song title, artist and album art link from your media tags
sends.why: to show song details on your viewer page (only with Sync metadata on)

sends.what: the plugin and FPP version numbers
sends.why: so Remote Falcon can tell which versions are in use

collects.what: a log of which songs were requested, voted for and played

systemChanges.what: runs a background listener while FPP is running, which checks Remote Falcon for the next request or vote
flags FPP for a restart after install and uninstall

privacy.other: Nothing is sent until you enter a Show Token. FPP commands you can run or schedule change your Remote Falcon account: viewer control on/off, managed PSA on/off, set the active viewer page, clear the queue or votes, and re-sync the remote playlist. Visitor requests and votes are handled by Remote Falcon's service, not stored on this device. The plugin log is rotated by FPP's own log rotation. Self-hosters can point the plugin at their own server under Developer Settings.
